verdict.rationale: Grok Bot runs on a persistent cloud computer with a filesystem and keeps its files across sessions. Its files-and-results docs list CSV, JSON, YAML, source-code files and Jupyter notebooks. A month-long user reports a bot generating a logo-based pattern and sending it to a supplier as a .ai file, which corroborates file creation. Missing for 10: explicit document and presentation creation, a documented iterative editing workflow for files, a documented export/download path, and independent hands-on corroboration for office-style documents.
